posts.title: Enhancement Request: ASC Reporting - Labor Snapshot Filters
posts.details:
Business Requirement: Currently the Labor Snapshot report in the Above Store Console includes all employees with punch records for the specified period selected by the user. You cannot exclude departments, hourly management, or other roles which you may not wish to include in the total calculated labor percentage. Primary reason for this idea: recent labor laws in California state that salaried management must be paid the equivalent of twice the current minimum wage. With some salaried managers in between this pay grade, teams are being moved to hourly. Because they are still classified as a non-variable labor cost in these instances it would benefit customers to remove them from the calculations in this report.

posts.title: On screen reports
posts.details:
When Internet Explorer was alive - we used to get lots of very simple reports from HR on  screen and with a click of one button we could select a detailed report or a summary per individual, department or location. 

One such example is the Lieu day report when with a couple of clicks we could find out when employees earned the lieu days, when taken and what still outstanding.  This report could be saved, shared, printed or exported to Excel and amended as needed.

These simple reports have disappeared and now you need a degree in Excel to filter so much data to find the simplest things. 

Can we please have this option back?

comments.author: Alison Barlow
comments.body:

Thanks for your post.  Mid 2022, we released a new reporting engine which allowed reports to be run in all browsers.  Part of this release was to ensure all on screen reports available via Internet Explorer were available in as close a format as possible in this new reporting engine.  These type of reports are called 'Normal - On screen' within the report page.  

There are also two additional formats.  Table Layout (simple) which is a basic report with the data shown on screen, and a Table layout (Advanced) which is another on screen report but gives additional options to group the report using any of the available columns.

posts.title: Lead and Lag  - Deploying labour over specific time period for scaled events eg weddings/ buffets
posts.details:
Many customers now book large events where sales are often processed over a single time frame but the labour associated with the event spans a much larger time frame mostly involving pre work before the sales are actually taken. We need a solution where events can be associated with a varying level of labour which ensures team are scheduled correctly and affects labour demand accordingly.

For example a wedding will require FOH team and BOH team in different scheduling requirements. A buffet can take varying amounts of time based on complexity but could be defined within a potential rule. FOH team can be scheduled based on forecasted sales eg drink sales ect but the set up, clean up and potential requirements during the wedding are not accounted for and affect labour deployment. These events may not be regular so fixed tasks and minimums would not apply. If rules could be added which takes into account the team required during a wedding which is activated upon sales being taken it could remove the large spikes on demand graphs and show correct hours.

posts.title: Able to make surname a non-mandatory field
posts.details:
We currently have a Colleague who only has one name legally, but we are unable to account for this correctly on the system,

If we enter something into the Surname box this will then not be an accurate record and will display incorrect information on the Colleagues Payslips etc
posts.author: Lorna Murray

comments.author: Alison Barlow
comments.body:
Hi 5883579832205

HMRC require both forename and surname as mandatory fields in the RTI submissions, so we are unable to make either field non-mandatory in employee records.

As having a single name is lawful in the UK, I contacted both CIPP and HMRC software development team.  Both confirmed that there is no way to submit an RTI file with only one field complete.  They could not advise on what should be entered into the surname field, and suggested you call HMRC directly to ask them.

If the employee has changed their name, then they should have registered it with HMRC, and assuming HMRC have updated the records accordingly, they should be able to tell you what they have recorded in each field, which could be replicated in the employee record.

I hope this helps

Kind Regards

Ali

posts.details:

posts.title: ATS - Vacancy Approval Workflow Improvements
posts.details:
The vacancy approval workflow is a useful bit of functionality that when enabled requires vacancies raised by Location Managers to be approved by a user on a higher permission level (eg. an Area Manager/Head Office user) before being published, however there are some issue with using it:

  • Once the vacancy raiser sends the vacancy for approval it cannot be edited. If there is a typo, advert mistake or issue with the offered rate/vacancy name this cannot be corrected - it would need to be declined and raised again, which is time consuming. We would like the approver to be able to make edits to the vacancy before approving.
  • If the user raising the vacancy is on an approver level they are still unable to publish a vacancy without it first going through the approval workflow. So if there are two levels of approval (Approver 1: Area Manager > Approver 2: Head Office) the vacancy raised by the Head Office user also needs an Area Manager, then a Head Office user to approve before being able to publish a vacancy. We would like in this case an Area Manager to only need a Head Office approval and a Head Office user no approval required.

posts.title: Target Labor % on Proforma Report
posts.details:
We use the Proforma By Percent report as tool to present future schedules and how they layout against the Forecasted Sales as well as how to compare Actuals vs Schedules when the week is over.

It would be very helpful if there was an area on the top right of the report page that showed what the "Budget Labor" percent is.  Or even a way to show the variance that the Actual vs Scheduled Labor has against the goal labor.

For example, our target in all wages is 24% but when a manager submits a schedule that is 29%, we want a way we can show this variance in whole on the page how far they are over or under from the Budget Labor.
posts.author: Randall Alonso

comments.author: Chris Sundgren
comments.body:
Hi Randall, 

I think this is supported but on other reports. You have access to create labor budgets (from the forecast menu, labor budgets). You can do this weekly or just have default budgets. This data will show up on the labor budget report as well as the scheduler. We have no plans to modify proforma reports at this time.

comments.author: Randall Alonso
comments.body: Yes, but from an operating standpoint, we have found that the Proforma report gives all information needed with just the right amount of detail to distribute this "one-sheet" report for monitoring performance and planning.  It can start to get complicated when from a higher-level, we ask managers to submit multiple reports and formats when I think this a small but extremely useful feature to add.  We have found that this is the one thing missing from the Proforma By Percent (which we love).  It would be to show how your Actual or Scheduled is lining up to the Labor Budget % you have set very similarly to the attached photo.  In our LBDG, example, our goal percent for the team is 18% so it would read as such.  I know you may not have any plans to modify the repot, but could we open this idea for voting if others like it?

comments.author: Chris Sundgren
comments.body: Absolutely! This feature request is open for voting. Thank you for the thoughtful response and business problem you're trying to solve with this report!

If we approve payroll 5 days before the pay date the payslips are automatically made visible on the engage app and if we need to amend anything on it - e.g. - salaried termination date prior to the pay date, deduction of earnings orders, etc, the employee will obviously receive a new payslip with different pay, and this can raise questions on why we are releasing 2 different payslips. More work and hassle for the employer to have to justify the changes. It would be much easier for us to be able to approve payroll 1 day prior to the payday since we are making our own BACS payments.

Hope the above makes sense.

Thank you beforehand.

comments.author: Brenden Goodwin
comments.body:
Hi Vikki,

Thank you for your post.

One option that may be suitable for you is the "Reserved Days" functionality.

HR > Administration > Global Settings > Default Holiday Settings > Reserved Days

Holidays can be entered here, then the system will allocate one of the employee's days to the reserved day and not let the employee book all of their holiday allowance without having a holiday booked in on the reserved days.

For example, if an employee has 28 days holiday allowance and you add 1 reserved day. 
 
The employee is able to book 27 days for whenever they like, the remaining day would have to be booked in on the reserved day.

Unfortunately, it would not currently be possible to mass increase the entitlement for every employee for every year at once, instead, each job title would need to be updated individually - WFM UK: UI Refresh HR: Creating a Job Title

posts.title: Barcode & PLU linked to product instead of detail
posts.details:
Currently, barcodes and PLUs must be linked to a product detail, but when we have two details based on how the item is purchased (for example, a case of 24 pieces from vendor X and a case of 12 pieces from vendor Y) but the inventory unit is the same, the inventory unit barcode is the same for both details, but Adaco only allows a barcode to be linked to one detail/item. Same with the PLU. So we are receiving the same inventoried item from different vendors in different purchase packs, but we can only inventory it under one particular detail.

I think it would make more sense to link the barcode, PLU, and even the average inventory cost (if the inventory unit is the same for all details) to the Adaco item number, instead of the detail number.
posts.author: Jillian Hillegass

comments.author: Chris Webb
comments.body:
Hi 6368044057229,

The reason we link both the PLU and the barcodes to the product details rather than the parent product is because they need to uniquely identify the actual package of the product that is either ordered, counted or sold.  Although you may have multiple details with the same inventory unit this is not always the case.  For example if you have a product "Lemonade" you may have one detail which is a case of 6 x 1lt bottles and a second detail which is a case of 24 x 330ml cans.  In this example the bar code of a 330ml can will be different to the barcode on a 1lt bottle so when ordering you need to be able to uniquely identify each product package.  Equally when deducting sales from inventory we need to know exactly which lemonade was sold which can only be achieved if both details have their own PLU.

comments.author: Jillian Hillegass

posts.title: Select All Function with Filters + AP Interface Log View
posts.details:
It would be great if the Select All Function (wherever it exists on Adaco) works the same way as within Excel.  We just had a major issue the other day where somebody filtered within the AP Interface and then clicked Select All, thinking that only the items that were visible after the filter were selected, but then it turned out to have selected everything within AP Interface to export.  That was a nightmare to restore.

Within the AP Interface Log view, it would be great to add a column for date of export so that we can filter by both person and date it was exported in case we need to reverse a mistake.
posts.author: Su Wang

comments.author: Chris Webb
comments.body:
Hi 8544133222157,

In relation to your first point about being able to use "select all" with filtered content: there are two ways to filter the invoices in the AP export screen; firstly there are the built in filter options at the top of the screen which let you filter the records that populate the grid in the lower part of the screen.  Secondly there are the filters at the top of each column which let you show or hide items within the grid. 

As the "select all" function selects all items within the grid, whether they are hidden or visible I would suggest that  you use the built in filters at the top of the screen to only return the invoices you are interested in and then use the "Select All" option to select them.

Your second point seems like a sensible idea which we will open for voting.

comments.author: Su Wang
comments.body: Thank you Chris.  We are aware of the different ways to search/filter within AP interface.  The first suggestion is really more around user friendliness.  It is a user friendliness issue if the select all checkbox always selects everything, not just the lines visible in a view since that's not what users are used to from other types of software.  The select all checkbox also appears in Property => User, when you're trying to give users permissions to outlets for example.  Say we want to give a Bar Manager access to all outlets with "beverage" in the name.  We are able to search by keyword on that screen, but if we check Select All, that selects all outlets as well, not just the ones with "beverage" in the name.  It would just be more user friendly and less prone to mistakes if the Select All checkbox, wherever it appears within Adaco, allows you to select only all lines that are visible after filtering/searching.

comments.body:
Hi James,

Thanks for your suggestion which we will open for voting, however in the meantime you may be interested to know that we have an API which allows you to import outlet requisitions.  I'm not sure what your use case is for importing requisitions but if the details of the requisitions are being created in another system then perhaps that other system could use the API to import the requisitions into Adaco.  Details of the API can be found in our developer website at Adaco Requisitions API Guide | Fourth

Also, and again I don't know what your use case is, but it is possible to have outlet requisitions automatically created based on par levels and current stock on hand.  Details of this functionality can be found at Adaco: Auto Create Outlet Requisitions – Fourth & HotSchedules Customer Success Portal and in this more recent release note September 5th & 7th 2023, Release Note: Adaco: Auto-Creation of Outlet Requisitions – Fourth & HotSchedules Customer Success Portal

Hopefully the above may help you but if not we will leave your idea open to voting so it is considered for future development.

Chris

posts.title: Auto-creation of Site Transfer Orders for Hub Kitchens
posts.details:
We have hub kitchens that produce food for their own school as well as other schools (delivered in primaries), and the current process is to only capture the total number of meals sent to the delivered in primary site, but no breakdown of the exact quantity of each recipe transferred.  Having to manually create site transfer orders and add quantities on a daily basis will increase administration for these kitchens.

As we will have an integrated external system capturing primary orders enabling early visibility of what needs to be produced for delivered in primaries, we would like to use the information from the external system to send an instruction to Fourth to auto-create site transfer orders from the hub kitchen to the related delivered in primary units so that once the meals have been produced the unit manager doesn't have to create the site transfer order from scratch and can simply dispatch the order.  We would like the ability to amend the site transfer order prior to dispatch in the event that extra meals are produced.

posts.details:
As a large business we often have last minute additions to menu cycles and we’re finding that the current functionality in Fourth is too restrictive for our needs.

When a central menu cycle is published to a site in Fourth, all menu items at that time are published to the site.  However, if we then add a subsequent item to the central menu cycle, we can see the additional items at local level but not at central level unless we view the MC History report.  

Furthermore, when the central menu cycle is then published to a new site, it still only publishes the original set of menu items and not the ones that have been added after the menu cycle had been first published, this means we need to find which MC has had an addition after the first publish, copy it, add in the addition into the meal periods and then use that one to publish to any new sites which is a long winded process for us with so many new sites coming on board.

We would like the following enhancements to the functionality:
1.    When a menu item is added to an already published central menu cycle, we should be able to add this into an existing meal period during the addition - the menu item should then show against the central menu cycle as well as the local menu cycle within the meal periods
2.    When an already published central menu cycle is published to a new site, all menu items regardless of when they were added to the central menu cycle should be published to the local menu cycle

Both these enhancements would ensure that the central and local menu cycles matched at all times as the majority of our MC’s are managed and maintained purely at head office.

comments.body:
Hi 5883579832205,

Thank you for reaching out to us with your inquiry regarding passive shift types. I would like to provide some clarification on this matter.

Passive Shift Reasons:

  • There is no limitation on the number of passive shift reasons you can create. You are free to define as many reasons as needed to suit your organizational requirements.
  • The only requirement is that each passive shift code must be unique and should not exceed 20 characters in length.

Creating Passive Shift Reasons:

  • To create a new passive shift reason in Scheduling, please follow these steps:
    1. Navigate to Settings > Passive Shift Reason Codes.
    2. Select "Create New" to define a new passive shift reason.
    3. Enter a name and a unique code for the passive shift reason.

posts.title: Scheduling/ T&A Gaps
posts.details:
Hello,

Re the Scheduling module for time and attendance, we would like to see the below changes:

1- As part of the end of day process, gain access to reporting on what the end of day status selected is for each employee. Eg, did not work, pay by schedule, pay by t&a. This will address the challenge of where operators purely select pay by schedule to circumvent the T&A process entirely.

2- Greying out, disabling or providing some further comments on where pay by schedule is used. It's far too easy to circumvent the process and this will allow reporting to drive the right behaviours. 

3- Operators currently amend the rota within the day, deleting shifts and creating new shifts for employees. This is another method to circumvent the process in its entirety. The proposal is:

- not allow shifts to be removed which were already on the rota from the prior day. This encourages the behaviour of completing the end of day actualisation as it is intended to be done

- not allow shifts to be amended which are already on the rota. Again, complete the manual overrides as intended.

- include shifts to be added for employees where they were not on the rota previously (prior day cut off) but worked. 

In addition, where more than 2 breaks are taken, it would be useful to see the additional breaks and the total breaks taken- otherwise we run the risk of paying for breaks.

These requirements are to ensure the system is able to provide operators and managers with the right tools to drive the right behaviours, as it's far too easy to circumvent the process with no visibility of where issues are arising. The tool currently provides a view on the outputs with the various inputs (even then a limited view, due to breaks reporting)- with these amendments, it completes the feedback loop on root cause analysis.

Thank you- I look forward to speaking soon.

Cheers,

 

Sunny

posts.title: IMPT: Absences reports & records to reflect hours of absence
posts.details:
We would like an absence to reflect 'scheduled-working hours' on that specific day.

Please, see below some scenarios:

Scenario 1: A waiter works a morning shift 09:00-13:00. He then takes 2 hrs break : he is scheduled to start his evening shift 16:00-22:00

Due to an emergency, the employee informs the Manager he cannot longer cover the evening shift in the restaurant. This reflects an 'evening' absence (not a whole day absence)

How can the company track if this 'Hours-Drop' was an employee's request or a Manager's offer? Would there be the possibility of inserting an absence on the specific day ( = an absence which reflects 'actual hrs of absence' on that specific day)? e.g. 'Hours-Drop-Absence'.

Scenario 2: A Bartender works a morning shift 09:00-13:00. She then takes 2 hrs break : she is scheduled to start her evening shift 16:00-22:00

The bartender start her evening shift at 16:00pm. However, as the bar section is quiet, at 17:00pm, Manager asks her if she would like to take the evening off. The Bartender accepts and goes home at 17pm. This would not classify as an 'evening' absence as ultimately it was a Manager's offer, not an employee's request to drop hours.

How can the company track if this 'hours-drop' was an employee's request or a Manager's offer? Would there be the possibility of inserting a 'partial' absence on the day ( = an absence which reflects 'actual hrs of absence' on that specific day)? e.g. 'Hours-Drop-Offer'.

It would also be ideal, when completing Time&Attendance for the day on Scheduling Module, to see the 'Total Hrs Scheduled' vrs 'Total Actual Hrs Worked' by the employee on that day, and tick either the option 'Hours-Drop-Offer' or 'Hours-Drop-Absence' when confirming the actual hrs dropped.

Ultimately when we run the weekly payroll-hours-worked report, we would like to be able to see the following columns:   'Actual Hrs Worked', 'Holiday Hrs Paid', 'Hrs Drop Absence', 'Hrs Drop Offer', 'Authorized Absence Hrs' , etc..

Would this be possible?

 

Vera

posts.title: Receiving Corrections & Split Receiving
posts.details:
We would like to explore a potential enhancement within the Receiving – Receiving Corrections module to support more efficient invoice matching by our Accounts Payable team.

Currently, once a PO has been received in full, AP does not have the access rights to update quantities. This creates a challenge when suppliers submit multiple invoices for a single PO. For example, if a property receiver posts a PO with 10 line items, but the supplier submits three separate invoices, AP must request the property receiver to manually split the original receiving (REC 1) into multiple new receivings (REC 2, REC 3, etc.) to match each invoice appropriately.

We are requesting the ability for AP to select specific line items from a fully received PO and manually split them into new receivings, without impacting the original Receiving Date or Posting Period. The new receivings would retain the original dates to ensure accounting integrity while allowing AP to match invoices more efficiently.

This functionality would ideally be governed by a specific access right to ensure proper control and accountability.

posts.title: Receiving EDI Invoicing Auto-Matching
posts.details:
We would like to revisit the current functionality of automated 3-way matching within Adaco, particularly as it relates to EDI Invoicing. As it stands, the system automatically applies invoices when the invoice matches the received quantities and the total amount falls within the defined price threshold and rounding tolerance. However, this matching process only occurs once—at the time the EDI invoice updates Adaco.

We are requesting an enhancement that would allow Adaco to re-attempt auto-matching based on a scheduled job task. This would enable the system to periodically check for matchable EDI invoices against existing PO receivings throughout the day, rather than relying on a single trigger point.

This change would address scenarios where a PO receiving has already been completed, but the receiver did not flag the receiving with the available EDI invoice. With a recurring scheduled job or trigger, Adaco could attempt to auto-match these invoices multiple times, increasing efficiency and reducing manual intervention by AP.

We believe this enhancement would significantly improve the reliability and effectiveness of the automated matching process and help us better leverage the benefits of EDI integration.

comments.author: Leslie Grogan
comments.body:
Hi Ignacio

Thank you for the quick reply and for the additional detail.  That is an interesting challenge.

Previous figures are hidden in the Counting app because showing historical data can encourage stock takers to confirm existing records rather than conduct independent assessments. This confirmation bias can reduce accuracy and mask real discrepancies. We try to follow best practice where we can so we are unlikely to change visibility of past records.

For items requiring estimation (like liquid levels), maybe your team could agree clear guidelines before the count —such as standard reference points (quarter-full, half-full, etc.) or having two counters agree on estimates before recording. This maintains counting independence while improving consistency.

posts.title: Issue with Night Cleaner Absence Recording for SSP  – Request for Full/Partial Absence Entry
posts.details:
I am reaching out regarding the records of some Night Cleaner employees on Fourth.

In this particular case, the employee’s shifts are as follows:

  • Evening shift from Monday 20th October, 23:00 to Tuesday 21st October, 06:00.

  • Evening shift from Tuesday 21st October, 23:00 to Wednesday 23rd October, 06:00.

  • Evening shift from Wednesday 23rd October, 23:00 to Thursday 24th October, 05:00.

The employee clocks in for their shift on Monday evening and clocks out at 06:00 am on Tuesday. However, on Tuesday afternoon, the employee contacts the restaurant and informs the Manager that they will be unable to attend their Tuesday evening shift (from 23:00 pm) due to illness. The employee then returns to work on Wednesday evening for their shift starting at 23:00 pm.

Because the employee clocked out at 06:00 am on Tuesday, the system does not allow us to record an absence for Tuesday 21st October, nor can we input an absence for Wednesday 22nd October, since the employee clocks in again at 23:00 pm.

However, the employee has been absent for more than 24 hours due to illness, and should therefore have 1 Waiting Day of SSP recorded.

It seems that the system is having trouble accurately reflecting the employee's absence in line with SSP rules, especially with the upcoming changes in April 2026, where SSP will be available from the first day of illness.

We would like to request the ability to insert a full day or half-day absence into the system for situations like this, allowing for better tracking and compliance with SSP regulations.

posts.title: Gender Identity - Sensitive Information
posts.details: Would it be possible to add in the ability for colleagues to select “Trans Male” and “Trans Female” to indicate preferred gender identity within the Sensitive Information list.
posts.author: Becka Lee

comments.author: Fourth Customer Success Portal
comments.body:
Hi 42135414202253,

Thank you for the suggestion. The available categories are aligned with NHS and national census standards, which require gender identity to be recorded using existing male/female fields. We are not able to consider making any changes to this at the moment. In line with this approach, a trans female colleague should select Female, and a trans male colleague should select Male.

Best wishes,
Fourth Communities Team

posts.title: Hotschedules App should be Free
posts.details:
Hotschedules app having a cost associated with downloading is a huge barrier to staff downloading the app.

Any chance to have this app offered for free?
posts.author: Alesha Birchfield

comments.author: Fiona Meldrum
comments.body:
38811205495693

Hi Alesha, thanks for the feedback — it's a really common question and a fair one.

Staff don't need the app to access their schedule; the web version is completely free and works on any mobile browser, so it's just as accessible on the go. For those who prefer a native app experience, there is a one-time download fee to help support ongoing development.

We appreciate you sharing this — input like yours is genuinely useful as we think about how the product evolves.

Best wishes,
Fourth Communities Team
